desc: Introducing the new Sledgehammer AR-15 Charging Handle from Breek Arms, built for shooters who demand rock-solid reliability and effortless manipulation, especially when running suppressed. Machined from aerospace-grade 7075-T6 aluminum with wide, serrated latches, it delivers rugged durability and a sure, snag-free grab for fast, confident charging. With industry-leading gas-reduction ports that direct fumes away from your face and performance-first engineering at an approachable price, the Sledgehammer is the smart upgrade your rifle needs this season.
